title: Sketch-to-photo divider glide
summary: A line-drawing layer and the finished photo of the same scene share one frame; a thin divider with a pill handle glides left, rests, comes back to centre, then returns home, so the viewer compares plan and result in one shot.
use_when: Showing a transformation: plan vs result, draft vs final, raw vs edited
Interior, renovation, retouch or design-tool reels where both states share one framing
A square or vertical feed loop with no cuts and a short two-line promise
Proof beat inside a longer film: the before/after carries the claim

look.type_style: regular text serif, sentence case, white, normal tracking, 2 lines top-left, ~5.5 % H per line, left margin ~6 % W; small white monogram mark bottom-left (~8 % W)

structure.shot: orange line-drawing of a room covers 87 % of the width, a sliver of the real photo right of a white divider with pill handle; 2-line headline, 7 words, names the transformation
structure.camera: static (layers fixed; motion.json zoom 0.2 %/s, not visible on sheets)
structure.motion: headline per-word fade left to right, starts by f8, complete by f15, easings.outExpo (±0.25 s); divider creeps 0.87 -> 0.83 W, easings.inOutSine 30 fr

structure.shot: divider glides left and reveals the photo of the same room; headline and mark stay on the drawing layer and are clipped by the divider
structure.motion: divider x 0.83 -> 0.18 W: 0.69 at 1.27, 0.46 at 1.50, 0.33 at 1.77, 0.28 at 2.00, 0.18 at 2.77; peak 0.23 W per 0.25 s at 1.27-1.50; springs.heavy ~50 fr, no overshoot (overshoot not measurable)

structure.shot: rest on the finished photo, a narrow orange strip with the clipped headline and mark at left
structure.motion: divider settles 0.18 -> 0.16-0.17 W, no visible rebound (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: divider glides back right, the drawing returns over the left half
structure.motion: divider x 0.17 -> 0.48 W: 0.19 at 4.77, 0.25 at 5.00, 0.37 at 5.27, 0.42 at 5.50, 0.45 at 5.77; peak at 5.00-5.27; springs.heavy ~45 fr (overshoot not measurable)

structure.shot: split near the centre: drawing left, photo right, headline cut mid-word by the divider
structure.motion: divider creeps 0.48 -> 0.52 W, easings.linear 45 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: divider glides right, the drawing covers the room again and the full headline returns
structure.motion: divider x 0.52 -> 0.85 W: 0.59 at 7.77, 0.72 at 8.00, 0.78 at 8.27, 0.81 at 8.50, 0.83 at 8.77; peak at 7.77-8.00; springs.heavy ~45 fr (overshoot not measurable)

structure.shot: hold on the opening composition: drawing with headline, photo sliver right of the divider
structure.motion: divider settles 0.85 -> 0.86 W; nothing else moves

params.brand: any brand.json: accent tints the before layer, fg colours the headline, divider and mark
params.content.before: image of the before state (sketch, draft, raw), same framing as after
params.content.after: image of the after state (photo, final, edited)
params.content.headline: 2-line promise, 6-8 words, on the before layer
params.content.tint: colour laid over the before image (default brand accent, multiply)
params.timing.stops: divider stops as share of width, default [0.87, 0.83, 0.17, 0.48, 0.52, 0.86]
params.timing.glides: glide start frames at 30 fps, default [30, 135, 225]

notes: One continuous shot, 0 cuts: row boundaries are speed changes of one divider. Divider positions measured from sheet cells (share of width, ±1 %). Three glides start at f30, f135, f225 and settle in 45-50 fr without visible overshoot; holds of 1.5 s between them. Headline and mark live on the before layer and are clipped by the divider. The two layers are the same room aligned 1:1 (drawing traced from the photo). Not loopable as is: the headline is absent at f0 and present at the end, the divider position matches. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (source is silent). Proposed term: divider-glide (two-state compare slider, not in vocabulary).
